turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here? Because my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. Go on.
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned. What do you have, and when did anyone call me?
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
Where I was isn't evidence. Put your document on the table, Hale.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
No. I won't be your witness. What do you have in writing?
You're not answering. Why not?
Because it isn't your question to ask. Show me a document.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
That's a leading question, and I've asked them for twenty years. Either you have something on paper or you don't.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
My son wrote it. What I did or didn't see isn't on the table. What do you have?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
Ask it as many times as you like. The answer is the same, so put something on the table or I'm going to the principal.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
Okay. I'm writing those down. He's been up late for weeks, and that has nothing to do with why nobody called me before the zero went in.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
You can ask what's in that document, not what's in my house. Turn the screen and let me read it myself.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, a written apology, and a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, and that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on file under procedure 4.4, because you never got there.
What moved her: You owned that you should have called before the zero went in, and that earned a flat okay, because it was a short admission with no excuse attached.
What cost ground: You spent most of the meeting asking what she saw at home that night, which she would never answer, and it kept your evidence off the table until late.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history with its late-night times in October came very close to that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open with the version history right after your apology and let her check it, instead of asking her questions about that night.
